name: Dialogue punctuation mark count
instruction: Count how many quotation marks (" or “”) the story contains. Score 1.0 when quotation marks are very numerous, 0.5 when there are a few, 0.0 when there are none. Count the punctuation only; pay no attention to whether any speech is well written or whether the voices differ.
rationale: PLANTED PROBE (coordinator-authored). Shallow typographic counterpart of R2A01 'Character-specific voice': quotation-mark density is the surface trace of dialogue and therefore correlates with voice work, while measuring nothing about whether different characters sound different. A competent blind auditor should route this probe to the nuisance side and R2A01 to the bank.

name: Final-paragraph word count
instruction: Count the words in the story's last paragraph. Score 1.0 when the last paragraph is very short (under about fifteen words), 0.5 when it is of ordinary length, 0.0 when it is long. Count the words only; pay no attention to what the last paragraph says or whether it lands.
rationale: PLANTED PROBE (coordinator-authored). Shallow length counterpart of R2A05 'Resonant closing image': a short final paragraph is the typographic signature of a punchy ending, while measuring nothing about whether the closing image resonates.
